tweets.text: You can reverse engineer w Astra https://t.co/CQSRC43PlX

Will Americans care that Instinct runs on Kimi? Not sure.

It’s a fast-growing consumer app on iMessage with access to inbox, cards, screen running on a Chinese model.

Meanwhile, Muse offers incredible capability on a closed American model. But what would have happened if they also used Kimi? 

It is going to be interesting to see how much this will matter going forward with other “American” consumer apps as well
